description: Should an agent pay this x402 endpoint? Pre-payment check of an UNKNOWN x402 URL: fetch it once (never pays) to validate the 402 challenge + accepts[] (scheme/network/payTo/amount/asset/resource = will it settle) AND scan the resource + any advertised MCP tools for LLM01/LLM08 prompt-injection and screen payTo against the OFAC SDN + community scam lists (safe to pay) AND verify the PRICE — does the live accepts[].amount match the advertised price? pass advertised=<usdc> (the figure your catalog quoted) or it self-checks the endpoint's /.well-known/x402: MATCH | OVERCHARGE | UNDERCHARGE. Optional samples=N (1-5) runs a reliability/payability burst (settle-consistency + latency; a flapping endpoint downgrades PAY to CAUTION). Returns verdict PAY | CAUTION | AVOID + per-check fix hints + latency. Read-only, never a settlement guarantee. Cost: $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

advertised.description: optional: the price (USDC dollars, e.g. 0.001) your catalog/listing quoted — returns MATCH/OVERCHARGE/UNDERCHARGE vs the live accepts[].amount; omit to self-check against the endpoint's own /.well-known/x402

samples.description: optional reliability burst: sample the 402 challenge N times (1-5) for settle-consistency + latency; default 1

url.description: the x402 endpoint URL to pre-check before paying

name: x402_preflight
